behavior_constraints: Any dpipe command accepts an optional global --audit <path> flag.
After command completion (success or error), an audit entry is appended to the JSON audit log at the given path.
Audit log file is a JSON array; created with single-element array if missing.
If existing file is a valid JSON array, append new entry and rewrite.
If existing file is not a valid JSON array, overwrite with single-element array containing just the new entry.
Audit log is 2-space indented JSON array with trailing newline.
Each audit entry has fields: command, args, timestamp, duration_ms, success, error, input_size, output_size.
args excludes the command name and the --audit flag and its value.
timestamp is UTC ISO 8601 formatted as 2006-01-02T15:04:05Z.
duration_ms is integer milliseconds of execution duration.
entities.summary: This round adds a global --audit flag that records per-command execution metadata to a JSON audit log, plus a new impute transform that fills empty cells using mean/median/mode statistics.

instruction_head:
Add the following capabilities to `dpipe`.

## New global flag: `--audit`

Any `dpipe` command can accept an optional `--audit <path>` flag. When present, after the command completes (successfully or with error), an execution metadata entry is appended to a JSON audit log file at the given path.
